title: Can the hottest key range carry the writes?
description: Change traffic concentration, item size, write sharding, and table capacity mode. The model keeps aggregate WCU and key-range pressure separate because either boundary can throttle a request.

profiles.label: Distributed user writes
profiles.detail: Many user IDs spread traffic; no individual user dominates the table.

profiles.label: Celebrity counter
profiles.detail: One popular entity attracts most updates and creates a key-range bottleneck.

profiles.label: Provisioned batch import
profiles.detail: Keys are sharded, but larger items push aggregate demand above configured WCU.
